name: snowflake
description: Snowflake-managed MCP server — governed data access, SQL execution, Cortex Analyst/Search/Agents

requirements: Snowflake account with a created MCP server object (CREATE MCP SERVER)
OAuth client (recommended) or a Programmatic Access Token bound to a least-privilege role
Enable the MCP API for the account
notes: An open-source alternative lives under Snowflake-Labs (repo Snowflake-Labs/mcp, npm snowflake-labs-mcp) — the snowflakedb org publishes a cursor plugin and Terraform provider, not an MCP server.
The account hostname must use hyphens instead of underscores (MCP clients fail to connect otherwise).
Since 2026-08-20 tools/call responses arrive as an SSE stream — send Accept: application/json, text/event-stream.
Dry-run primitive: expose CORTEX_ANALYST_MESSAGE — it generates SQL and returns the statement without executing it.
Managed tool names are user-defined in the server spec YAML, so pin behaviour to tools/list rather than hardcoded names.
